core_obligations: Compute the stalk (proof lines 18267-18273): by the theorem on stalks of pushforwards, (f_*F)_s = Gamma(X x_S Spec(O^sh_{S,s}), p_small^{-1}F) for the projection p.

Identify with the fibre (proof lines 18274-18279): the strict henselian local ring has residue field the separable closure of kappa(s), so the h^0 proper comparison for a henselian base identifies those sections with Gamma(X_s, F_s), which is the assertion.
proof_roadmap: Write the stalk of the pushforward as sections over the base change along the strict henselisation.
Apply the h^0 comparison for a proper morphism over a henselian local base.

The proof (proof lines 18266-18279) writes the stalk as sections over the base change along the strict henselisation by the stalk theorem, and applies the h^0 comparison over the henselian local base. H2: two identifications, written out.
